what: Tag sites used by this experiment, copied out of the accessible-surfaceome deterministic tag_sites pipeline. Recorded HERE because that pipeline is still in progress -- its viewer/public/tag-sites/*.json store is the input to the public D1 sync, and we deliberately did NOT commit or publish these runs there.
command: uv run python scripts/regenerate_tag_sites.py --gene SLC2A4 P14672 --gene MS4A1 P11836 --gene SLC20A2 Q08357

pipeline_inputs.structure: AlphaFold DB model fetched by accession, cached under data/cache/afdb_pdb/
pipeline_inputs.uniprot_features: fetched live; used only as a hazard VETO (disulfide, glycosylation, binding/active site, modified residue, cross-link)
pipeline_inputs.conservation: mouse + cyno ortholog sequences from the Surfaceome API record

not_published.official_json_store: runs left untracked; the four by-product genes (SLC39A14, HTR3A, ASTN1, and the SLC20A2 re-run) are not needed and were removed

ranking_note: The emitted JSON is sorted lexicographically by site_id, which is NOT a ranking. The surface_loop path ranks by (-own RSA, conservation, -gap_freq); pLDDT is a >=70 pass/fail reliability gate only.

SLC2A4.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (11 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features
ordered surface loop (9 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

MS4A1.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (13 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features
ordered surface loop (13 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

SLC20A2.rationale: exposed, 3D-clear insertion point within a low-pLDDT disordered extracellular run (>=4 aa)
ordered surface loop (10 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features
extracellular C-terminus (topology 'O' at residue L) — direct C-terminal tag
extracellular N-terminus (topology 'O' at residue 1) — direct N-terminal tag
